related.title: OpenSSL mTLS：用途驗證與雙向身分
related.titleEn: OpenSSL mTLS: purpose checks and mutual identity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：48與88毫秒僅標為模型值；所有認證檢查保留，早期資料的重播邊界有清楚說明。 交付握手時序、兩組延遲預算與不含秘密的轉錄欄位清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Label 48 and 88 ms as model values, preserve authentication checks and explicitly document early-data replay boundaries. Deliver the handshake sequence, two latency budgets and transcript-field inventory without secrets.
related.difference: 在離線測試資料夾設計三個客戶端、兩個服務、兩種EKU狀態；每列分開記錄伺服器驗客戶與客戶驗伺服器，無需對外開埠。
related.differenceEn: Design three clients, two services and two EKU states in an offline fixture folder; record server-to-client and client-to-server verification separately without external listeners.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本題簡化握手延遲=一個網路RTT+兩端合計計算時間；不含DNS、TCP建連與應用回應，不能當網頁總延遲。 合成鏈路RTT40毫秒，端點計算合計8毫秒；無HelloRetryRequest或封包遺失。 40+8=48毫秒；RTT改80毫秒、計算不變時為88毫秒。
mTLS建立兩個方向的認證，授權仍需獨立決定；完整測試矩陣數為客戶端×服務×用途狀態。 基準3客戶端、2服務、2種EKU狀態；每一組指定允許或拒絕及原因。 3×2×2=12組；加入第4個客戶端後4×2×2=16組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified handshake latency is one network RTT plus combined endpoint computation; it excludes DNS, TCP setup and application response and is not total page latency. A synthetic link has RTT 40 ms and combined computation 8 ms, with no HelloRetryRequest or loss. 40+8=48 ms; RTT 80 ms with unchanged computation gives 88 ms.

mTLS authenticates in both directions but authorization remains separate; complete tests equal clients×services×purpose states. Baseline uses 3 clients, 2 services and 2 EKU states; each combination has an expected decision and reason. 3×2×2=12 combinations; adding a fourth client gives 4×2×2=16.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: pfSense：狀態表容量與規則變更驗證
related.titleEn: pfSense: state-table capacity and rule-change validation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：48與88毫秒僅標為模型值；所有認證檢查保留，早期資料的重播邊界有清楚說明。 交付握手時序、兩組延遲預算與不含秘密的轉錄欄位清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Label 48 and 88 ms as model values, preserve authentication checks and explicitly document early-data replay boundaries. Deliver the handshake sequence, two latency budgets and transcript-field inventory without secrets.
related.difference: 把規則允許、NAT轉換與已建立state分三層；使用合成連線到達率與生命期，估算穩態state需求而不執行壓力攻擊。
related.differenceEn: Separate rule permission, NAT translation and established state; estimate steady-state demand from synthetic arrivals and lifetimes without traffic attacks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本題簡化握手延遲=一個網路RTT+兩端合計計算時間；不含DNS、TCP建連與應用回應，不能當網頁總延遲。 合成鏈路RTT40毫秒，端點計算合計8毫秒；無HelloRetryRequest或封包遺失。 40+8=48毫秒；RTT改80毫秒、計算不變時為88毫秒。
在穩態且沒有提前回收的簡化模型，平均states≈每秒新連線λ×平均生命W；尖峰與重傳需另留容量。 λ=400個新連線/秒，平均W=30秒；流量平穩且每連線占一個state。 400×30=12000個state；平均生命延至60秒時為24000個。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified handshake latency is one network RTT plus combined endpoint computation; it excludes DNS, TCP setup and application response and is not total page latency. A synthetic link has RTT 40 ms and combined computation 8 ms, with no HelloRetryRequest or loss. 40+8=48 ms; RTT 80 ms with unchanged computation gives 88 ms.

In a simplified steady state without early eviction, average states≈arrival rate λ×mean lifetime W; bursts and retries need separate headroom. λ=400 new connections per second and W=30 seconds, with steady arrivals and one state per connection. 400×30=12000 states; lifetime 60 seconds yields 24000.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
